name: H ~Itsuka Tadoritsuketa Ano Basho~
original_name: H ～いつかたどりつけた場所～
source:
During track and field's activities, Fujiwara Jun injured his dominant foot. Unable to run, he is spending days in frustration. At that time, his childhood friend Tsukamoto Azusa comes to comfort him, saying they will search for something new to be absorbed into together. At those words, dark passion wakes up in his heart full of suppressed emotions.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
藤原淳参加田径活动时伤到了惯用脚。无法奔跑的他每天都在沮丧中度过。这时，青梅竹马塚本梓前来安慰他，说两人可以一起寻找新的事物并全心投入。听到这句话，压抑已久的情感在他心中唤醒了黑暗激情。
